## Why

After the operator moves `surveillancegraph.org` to its Cloudflare
nameservers (OP-09, the P34.50 row's obligation), the ratified A-3 posture
must be *proven*, not assumed: the Cloudflare pair serving the zone, the
grey-cloud/DNS-only apex+www records still pointing at the Google LB
(`136.81.80.102`), DNSSEC with the Cloudflare DS replacing legacy `17039`,
the managed cert `sig-web-cert` `ACTIVE` toward its 2026-12-22 expiry,
every public route answering, the mail posture correct, and no
registrar-lock drift. The ticket forbids every production mutation — the
probe is reads only.

## What ships

- **`ops/src/ops/post_cutover_probe.py` (new)** — the read-only probe.
  `ProbeRunner` protocol with `LiveRunner` (executes only argv that passes
  `argv_is_readonly` — a mutating argv raises before `subprocess` sees it)
  and `CaptureRunner` (replays a capture directory offline). Parsers for
  dig answer/flags/status, curl HEAD, openssl x509 dates+SAN, gcloud JSON,
  WHOIS `Domain Status:` lines. `run_probe(leg)` emits a
  `sig.probe-run/1` record with per-check verdicts
  (`pass`/`fail`/`skipped` — a missing tool is `skipped`, never faked),
  `cutover_detected`, and `overall`.
- **`sig-ops post-cutover-probe`** (`ops/src/ops/cli.py`) —
  `--leg l1|l2`, `--capture <dir>` (preserves every raw output for the
  ledger), `--from-capture <dir>` (offline replay), `--out`, and
  `--domain`/`--expected-ip`/`--cert`/`--project` with `SIG_WEB_*` /
  `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` env defaults so the same probe measures a staging
  endpoint (HG-12 convention). Exit 0 on pass/partial, 1 on fail.
- **`docs/build/reports/POST_CUTOVER_PROBE_CHECKLIST.md` (new)** — the
  committed checklist: every L1 check mapped to the
  `DNS_CUTOVER_RUNBOOK.md` post-switch step it discharges (`ns_pair`,
  `apex_a`/`www_a` + the Cloudflare-anycast grey-cloud refusal, DNSSEC `ad`
  + RRSIG + parent DS rollover incl. the double-DS mid-state, TLS SAN +
  dates, `cert_status` managed `ACTIVE`, `www_redirect`/`http_redirect`
  with default-port normalisation, the `routes` sweep over sitemap locs
  with the `ops/public_routes.toml` allowlist fallback, the two-state
  `mail` posture `no_mail`/`op10_configured`, `registrar_lock` drift) and
  the L2 renewal read (`renewal_read` + `cert_status` + SAN + `ns_pair`).
- **`tests/ops/test_post_cutover_probe.py` (44 tests)** — the read-only
  argv contract, every parser, the good post-cutover state all-green, the
  **real 2026-10-10 pre-cutover capture** reporting
  `cutover_detected: not_detected` while every OP-09-independent check
  measures green, and every failure mode (missing `ad`, legacy-DS-only,
  absent/wrong-SAN cert, `PROVISIONING` managed status, anycast A answer,
  wrong IP, www not redirecting, both mail postures + drift,
  pending-transfer WHOIS, absent tools → skipped).
- **`tests/ops/fixtures/post_cutover/`** — `precutover/` (the real
  capture, labelled — fixture input, never post-cutover evidence) and
  `good/` (the expected post-cutover capture shape).
- **RETURN PASS** — `return_pass.toml` row `P35.67` (two legs) +
  regenerated LEDGER region; `CHANGELOG.md` entry; the run ledger
  `docs/build/runs/P35.67.md` records the pre-cutover baseline verbatim.

independent checks green (A records, HTTPS, both redirects, TLS SAN,
cert `ACTIVE`, mail, registrar lock, routes). The L2 machinery was
